commentary.text: 90+18' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+15' 4 - 3 Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) sends Marco Bizot the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
90+15' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+13' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gift Orban (Lyon) comes onto the pitch for Alexandre Lacazette.
90+11' It’s a PENALTY to Lyon after the VAR review!
90+11' There's a break in play and referee Mathieu Vernice must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lyon using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+10' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Marco Bizot (Brest) for a tough tackle.
90+9' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Nemanja Matic (Lyon), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+9' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+5' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Steve Mounie (Brest) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Romain Del Castillo and he is replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
89' Substitution. Said Benrahma makes his way off the pitch and Henrique (Lyon) comes on as his replacement.
87' Bradley Locko (Brest) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
87' It's like he was asking for a caution. Jake O'Brien (Lyon) receives a yellow card.
86' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is off! He saw a red card after two yellow cards.
86' It's the second caution for Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Mathieu Vernice.
83' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) replacing Martin Satriano.
80' That's the end of the game for Julien Le Cardinal, who is replaced by Luc Zogbe (Brest).
79' 3 - 3 Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
77' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' This shall not pass! Mahdi Camara (Brest) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
75' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Lyon is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
72' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Kamory Doumbia will be replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
70' 2 - 3 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:3.
70' Lyon take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
68' The substitution is prepared. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Malick Fofana.
68' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Corentin Tolisso is replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
67' 1 - 3 Romain Del Castillo (Brest) receives a perfect pass for a great chance inside the box and slots the ball past the goalkeeper.

64' 1 - 2 Romain Del Castillo (Brest) adds a goal to the scoreboard, scoring from the free kick just outside the box. His accurate shot flew in under the crossbar and ended up behind the keeper. A spectacular football moment which you don't see every day.
64' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! Brest have a free kick from a promising distance.
63' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

60' 1 - 1 Steve Mounie (Brest) celebrates a beautiful goal. He rises above the defence inside the box and scores with a bullet header from the free kick. The ball goes low into the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper didn't have a chance to save that close-range header.
60' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
59' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) picked up a yellow card from referee.
57' Said Benrahma (Lyon) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
57' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

57' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert and makes a decent save. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
54' Steve Mounie (Brest) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
53' Said Benrahma (Lyon) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
50' Said Benrahma (Lyon) is adjudged offside.
47' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

47' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Marco Bizot was alert and the score remains the same. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest). Mathieu Vernice doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

41' A nice pass finds Martin Satriano (Brest) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top of the net, but Anthony Lopes pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him. Good work from Brest as they win a corner.
40' A dangerous towering header by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
40' Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' Malick Fofana (Lyon) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
37' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. Clinton Mata (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play.

34' Ambitious effort from Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
29' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Mathieu Vernice had a clear view and blows his whistle.
28' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
27' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' A player from Lyon commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
26' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.

25' Lilian Brassier (Brest) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' The linesman points to the corner flag, Brest are going to take it.
24' Steve Mounie (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Brest earn a corner.

23' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) fails to beat the keeper from a good chance. He received a nice lofted pass inside the box and shot towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper deflected the ball onto the post with a quick reaction save and maybe some luck.
21' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 1:0.
17' Mathieu Vernice shows the yellow card to Lilian Brassier (Brest) for a heavy challenge.

16' Steve Mounie (Brest) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out.
13' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Anthony Lopes intercepts the ball.
12' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon).
8' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the right post.
7' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), but Marco Bizot is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
3' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
2' Said Benrahma (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
2' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brest will kick the game off.
Mathieu Vernice is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
